title: A Dodecanuclear Dysprosium Wheel Assembled by Six Vertex-Sharing Dy3 Triangles Exhibiting Slow Magnetic Relaxation

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.formula: [Dy12(L)6(OH)4O2(CO3)6][Dy12(L)6(OH)4O4(CO3)6](ClO4)4·xH2O (L = N1,N3-bis(3-methoxysalicylidene)diethylenetriamine; analytical formula C252H292Cl4Dy24N36O124 for 10 H2O per formula)

material_class.structural_family: dodecanuclear wheel of six vertex-sharing Dy3 triangles (staggered double crown); two crystallographically unique Dy12 units in the crystal

synthesis.procedure: SI: Dy(ClO4)3·6H2O (0.15 mmol, 0.0852 g) was reacted with H2L (0.15 mmol, 0.3 mL of a 0.5 mmol mL−1 methanol solution) in methanol/acetonitrile (1:2), then triethylamine (0.3 mmol, 42 μL) was added, giving a pale-yellow solution. Yellow crystals of the dodecanuclear complex formed after seven days. Yield 37% based on the metal salt. The main text describes the same Ln(ClO4)3·6H2O / H2L / MeOH–MeCN (1:2) / NEt3 route and 7-day crystallization but without reagent quantities. Carbonate is incorporated by slow fixation of atmospheric CO2. H2L itself was prepared by refluxing diethylenetriamine (2.575 g, 25 mmol) and o-vanillin (7.6 g, 50 mmol) in ethanol (100 mL) for 5 h, evaporating the solvent, and dissolving the oil in methanol (100 mL).

reagents.name: N1,N3-bis(3-methoxysalicylidene)diethylenetriamine
reagents.amount: 0.15 mmol, 0.3 mL of 0.5 mmol mL−1 methanol solution

synthesis.time: 7 days for crystallization of 1; ligand reflux 5 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by slow crystallization; atmospheric CO2 fixation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: pale-yellow solution; yellow crystals after seven days

properties.summary: DC susceptibility (1000 Oe) shows χMT = 147.02 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, below the 170.04 cm3 K mol−1 expected for 12 noninteracting Dy3+ ions, falling to 83.43 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, attributed to antiferromagnetic interactions and field saturation. Magnetization reaches 59.59 μB at 1.9 K and 7 T, far below 120 μB, indicating strong ligand-field anisotropy. Under zero dc field, frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac susceptibility indicates the onset of slow magnetization relaxation, but no hysteresis is observed on a conventional SQUID; SMM behavior was not confirmed.

measurements.name: ac susceptibility
measurements.conditions: zero dc field, 3.0 Oe ac field, 3–1200 Hz; frequency-dependent χ″ above 1.9 K, no hysteresis

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.formula: [Ho12(L)6(OH)4O2(CO3)6][Ho12(L)6(OH)4O4(CO3)6](ClO4)4·xH2O (L = N1,N3-bis(3-methoxysalicylidene)diethylenetriamine; analytical formula C252H292Cl4Ho24N36O124 for 10 H2O per formula)

material_class.structural_family: dodecanuclear wheel of six vertex-sharing Ho3 triangles, isomorphous with the Dy analogue

synthesis.procedure: Prepared as for complex 1, replacing Dy(ClO4)3·6H2O with Ho(ClO4)3·6H2O (0.15 mmol, reported as 0.0889 mg) and using 70 μL of triethylamine. Yellow crystals formed after the same seven-day crystallization. Yield 32% based on the metal salt. The main text groups 1 and 2 in one qualitative procedure without quantities.

reagents.amount: 0.15 mmol, 0.0889 mg (as printed in the SI)

reagents.name: N1,N3-bis(3-methoxysalicylidene)diethylenetriamine
reagents.amount: as for complex 1: 0.15 mmol, 0.3 mL of 0.5 mmol mL−1 methanol solution

synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by slow crystallization; atmospheric CO2 fixation

properties.summary: χMT is 143.98 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K (expected 169 cm3 K mol−1 for 12 noninteracting Ho3+) and decreases to 62.46 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization reaches 59.53 μB at 1.9 K and 7 T versus an expected saturation of 120 μB. No out-of-phase ac signal is detected under zero dc field, so slow relaxation is not observed for the Ho12 wheel.
